body.description: Tillbit: a small farm tractor creature, big rear wheels and small front wheels, a rounded hood like a snout with headlight eyes, an exhaust stack like a horn, a little tiller rake on its back, red paint. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
